name: Meghalaya Hidden Paradise
overview: A journey into the abode of clouds, from Shillong's pine hills to the living root bridges of Cherrapunji and the glass-clear Umngot river at Dawki, ending in the spotless village of Mawlynnong.
recommended_experiences: Trek to the Double Decker living root bridge near Nongriat
Boat over the crystal Umngot river at Dawki
Walk through Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest village

itinerary.title: Arrive Shillong
itinerary.detail: Arrive from Guwahati, settle in and explore Ward's Lake and Police Bazaar in the evening.

itinerary.title: Shillong & Umiam Lake
itinerary.detail: Visit Umiam Lake, Elephant Falls and Shillong Peak; enjoy the city's live-music cafes.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji waterfalls
itinerary.detail: Drive to Sohra for Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Cave and Seven Sisters Falls.

itinerary.title: Double Decker root bridge trek
itinerary.detail: A full-day trek to the double-decker living root bridge at Nongriat.

itinerary.title: Dawki & Mawlynnong
itinerary.detail: Boat on the Umngot river, then visit the Riwai root bridge and Mawlynnong village.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Drive back to Shillong/Guwahati for onward travel.

travel_tips: Carry cash; card acceptance is limited outside Shillong.
The root-bridge trek is strenuous—wear proper shoes.
Roads are slow and winding; keep buffer time.

name: Sikkim Hidden Beauty
overview: From cheerful Gangtok to the Kanchenjunga views of Pelling and the offbeat Silk Route hamlet of Zuluk, this trip balances monasteries, mountains and quiet villages.
recommended_experiences: Catch sunrise over the zig-zag Silk Route road at Zuluk
See head-on Kanchenjunga views from Pelling
Walk the litter-free MG Marg in Gangtok

itinerary.title: Arrive Gangtok
itinerary.detail: Drive up from NJP/Bagdogra; evening stroll on MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok sightseeing
itinerary.detail: Rumtek Monastery, Ganesh Tok and (with permit) Tsomgo Lake.

itinerary.title: To Zuluk
itinerary.detail: Drive the historic Silk Route to the tiny hamlet of Zuluk.

itinerary.title: Zuluk to Pelling
itinerary.detail: Sunrise at Thambi View Point, then transfer west to Pelling.

itinerary.title: Pelling circuit
itinerary.detail: Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse ruins, Khecheopalri Lake and the skywalk.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Descend to NJP/Bagdogra for departure.

travel_tips: Zuluk needs a protected-area permit and registered guide.
Carry warm layers even in summer.
Book high-altitude excursions through licensed operators.

name: Spiti Valley Journey
overview: A high-altitude expedition into the Trans-Himalayan cold desert of Spiti, taking in ancient monasteries, the world's highest villages and the glacial Chandratal lake.
recommended_experiences: Stay in a homestay in Langza beneath the giant Buddha
Post a letter from the world's highest post office at Hikkim
Camp beside the crescent Chandratal lake

itinerary.title: Shimla / Manali start
itinerary.detail: Begin the acclimatisation drive from Shimla or Manali towards Spiti.

itinerary.title: Into Kinnaur
itinerary.detail: Overnight in the apple-orchard village of Kalpa facing Kinnaur Kailash.

itinerary.title: Reach Kaza
itinerary.detail: Cross into Spiti and settle in Kaza, the valley's main town.

itinerary.title: Key & high villages
itinerary.detail: Key Monastery, then Langza, Komic and Hikkim.

itinerary.title: Pin Valley
itinerary.detail: Explore the Pin Valley National Park and its villages.

itinerary.title: Chandratal
itinerary.detail: Drive via Kunzum Pass to camp near Chandratal lake.

itinerary.title: To Manali
itinerary.detail: Cross Rohtang towards Manali.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.detail: Onward journey from Manali.

travel_tips: Acclimatise gradually to avoid altitude sickness.
Carry cash and fuel up at Kaza.
Roads are open only in summer; check conditions.

name: Uttarakhand Hidden Gems
overview: A blend of the spiritual and the wild, from the yoga-and-rafting hub of Rishikesh to the alpine meadows of Chopta and the trek to Tungnath, the world's highest Shiva temple.
recommended_experiences: Attend the evening Ganga Aarti at Rishikesh
Trek from Chopta to Tungnath and Chandrashila summit

itinerary.title: Arrive Rishikesh
itinerary.detail: Settle in; evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni or Parmarth Niketan.

itinerary.title: Rafting & yoga
itinerary.detail: Morning white-water rafting, afternoon yoga and the Beatles Ashram.

itinerary.title: Drive to Chopta
itinerary.detail: Scenic mountain drive via Devprayag and Ukhimath to Chopta.

itinerary.title: Tungnath trek
itinerary.detail: Trek to Tungnath temple and continue to Chandrashila summit for Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Chopta to Rishikesh
itinerary.detail: Return drive with photo stops along the river confluences.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.detail: Departure from Rishikesh/Dehradun.

travel_tips: Rishikesh's core town is vegetarian and alcohol-free.
The Tungnath trek is steep; carry water and warm layers.

name: Gujarat Heritage & Narmada Trail
overview: A compact central-Gujarat circuit from royal Vadodara to the UNESCO ruins of Champaner, the serene Narmada temple town of Poicha and the record-breaking Statue of Unity.
recommended_experiences: Tour the vast Laxmi Vilas Palace in Vadodara
Climb Pavagadh hill to Kalika Mata temple
See the Statue of Unity light-and-sound show

itinerary.title: Vadodara
itinerary.detail: Laxmi Vilas Palace, Sayaji Baug and the museums; try Baroda's famous sev usal.

itinerary.title: Champaner-Pavagadh
itinerary.detail: Day trip to the archaeological park and the hilltop Kalika Mata temple.

itinerary.title: Poicha & Narmada
itinerary.detail: Visit the peaceful Nilkanthdham temple complex on the Narmada.

itinerary.title: Statue of Unity
itinerary.detail: Explore Kevadia's attractions and the world's tallest statue before departure.

travel_tips: October to February is the comfortable season.
The Statue of Unity is closed on Mondays.
A hired car is the easiest way to link these sites.

name: Rajasthan Forts & Lakes
overview: A Mewar journey pairing the lake city of Udaipur with the colossal Kumbhalgarh fort and the astonishing marble Jain temple of Ranakpur.
recommended_experiences: Sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola
Walk a stretch of Kumbhalgarh's 36 km wall

itinerary.title: Udaipur
itinerary.detail: City Palace, Jagdish Temple and a Lake Pichola sunset cruise.

itinerary.title: Udaipur gardens
itinerary.detail: Saheliyon Ki Bari, Bagore Ki Haveli and the old-city bazaars.

itinerary.title: Kumbhalgarh
itinerary.detail: Explore the great fort and its wildlife-rich surroundings; evening light-and-sound show.

itinerary.title: Ranakpur
itinerary.detail: Visit the marble Chaumukha Jain temple, then return towards Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.detail: Departure from Udaipur.

travel_tips: Winter is by far the best season.
Leather items are not allowed inside Ranakpur temple.
Combine with Jodhpur or Mount Abu if you have more days.
